title: Fermentation of mulberry leaf extract by Aspergillus chevalieri CTCF-AC-1 for flavor improvement and enhanced hypoglycemic activity.
authors: Li, Xuezhen; He, Fatao; Lv, Xuqiang; Ma, Yanrui; Meng, Yuan; Lu, Xueyao; Zhao, Yan; Tian, Jiewei; Liu, Guangpeng; Wu, Maoyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桑叶提取物经真菌发酵改善风味和降糖活性，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
abstract: Mulberry leaf extract (MLE) is rich in bioactive compounds with potent hypoglycemic activity, but is constrained by its sensory drawbacks. In this study, Aspergillus chevalieri CTCF-AC-1, isolated from Fu brick tea, was employed to ferment MLE for improving both its flavor profile and functional efficacy. Fermentation dynamically remodeled MLE composition: total phenolic acids decreased from 859.8 to 566.5 mg/mL, while total amino acid content increased dramatically from 322.13 mg/mL to 570.31 mg/mL with methionine and cysteine increased by 111.5-fold and 5.4-fold, respectively. The content of 1-deoxynojirimycin (1-DNJ) remained stable (0.27-0.29 mg/g). Headspace-gas chromatography-ion mobility spectrometry (HS-GC-IMS) analysis identified 62 volatile compounds, revealing a reduction in bitter/astringent notes (2,3,5-trimethylpyrazine, butyric acid, etc.) and an increase in compounds associated with fruity and sweet aromas (d-3-hexanone, 2,3-dimethylpyrazine etc.). Furthermore, the fermented MLE (FMLE) exhibited significantly enhanced in vitro antioxidant activity and inhibitory effects on alpha-amylase and alpha-glucosidase. In a zebrafish hyperglycemia model, FMLE showed lower acute toxicity (LC(1) = 1109 mug/mL vs. 609 mug/mL for MLE) and superior efficacy in promoting pancreatic glucose uptake in a dose-dependent manner. Transcriptomic and QPCR analyses elucidated that FMLE's hypoglycemic mechanism involves regulation of key genes (fut9d, irg1l, mmp9, gck) implicated in glucose metabolism and immune response. These findings demonstrate that fermentation with A. chevalieri effectively alleviates the sensory limitations of MLE while enhancing its hypoglycemic potency and biocompatibility, providing a scientific basis for its use in functional foods and nutraceuticals.
abstract_zh: 桑叶提取物（MLE）富含具有强效降糖活性的生物活性化合物，但其感官缺陷限制了其应用。本研究利用从茯砖茶中分离的 Aspergillus chevalieri CTCF-AC-1 发酵 MLE，以改善其风味特征和功能功效。发酵动态重塑了 MLE 的组成：总酚酸从 859.8 mg/mL 降至 566.5 mg/mL，而总氨基酸含量从 322.13 mg/mL 显著增加至 570.31 mg/mL，其中蛋氨酸和半胱氨酸分别增加了 111.5 倍和 5.4 倍。1-脱氧野尻霉素（1-DNJ）含量保持稳定（0.27-0.29 mg/g）。顶空气相色谱-离子迁移谱（HS-GC-IMS）分析鉴定出 62 种挥发性化合物，显示苦味/涩味相关化合物（2,3,5-三甲基吡嗪、丁酸等）减少，而果香和甜香相关化合物（d-3-己酮、2,3-二甲基吡嗪等）增加。此外，发酵 MLE（FMLE）表现出显著增强的体外抗氧化活性以及对 α-淀粉酶和 α-葡萄糖苷酶的抑制效果。在斑马鱼高血糖模型中，FMLE 显示出较低的急性毒性（LC(1) = 1109 μg/mL，而 MLE 为 609 μg/mL），并以剂量依赖方式促进胰腺葡萄糖摄取，表现出更优功效。转录组和 QPCR 分析阐明，FMLE 的降糖机制涉及调节与葡萄糖代谢和免疫反应相关的关键基因（fut9d、irg1l、mmp9、gck）。这些发现表明，A. chevalieri 发酵有效缓解了 MLE 的感官限制，同时增强了其降糖效力和生物相容性，为其在功能食品和营养保健品中的应用提供了科学依据。
